assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls builder.Services.AddIdentityServer() to register IdentityServer services in DI
assertions.rationale: Program.cs calls builder.Services.AddIdentityServer() chained with the in-memory store methods.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddInMemoryApiScopes with a scope named 'api1'
assertions.rationale: It calls .AddInMemoryApiScopes(Config.ApiScopes) and Config defines new ApiScope("api1", "My API").

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddInMemoryClients with a client having ClientId 'm2m.client' and AllowedGrantTypes set to ClientCredentials
assertions.rationale: Config.Clients defines a Client with ClientId = "m2m.client" and AllowedGrantTypes = GrantTypes.ClientCredentials, registered via .AddInMemoryClients(Config.Clients).

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls app.UseIdentityServer() in the middleware pipeline before app.UseAuthorization()
assertions.rationale: The pipeline places app.UseIdentityServer() immediately before app.UseAuthorization().
app.UseRouting() precedes app.UseIdentityServer() in the pipeline.
